items.title: Entrepreneur says the rich should stop complaining about tax changes
items.description: Start-up founders say the federal government's CGT changes may see investment in new businesses go offshore. But Airtree Ventures co-founder Daniel Petre is warning against a scare campaign.

items.title: One Nation set to become federal opposition, poll predicts
items.description: One Nation would win dozens of seats if a federal election was held today, according to a major opinion poll.

items.title: Why there's more talk of an AUKUS 'plan B'
items.description: Defence industry experts argue Australia should consider how to prevent a naval "capability gap" — or risk being left exposed.

items.title: How the Musk v Altman case revealed an 'uncomfortable' truth
items.description: After Sam Altman and OpenAI's recent victory in a drawn-out legal battle with billionaire Elon Musk, the bitter rivalry between the former friends is now set to move from the courtroom to Wall Street.

items.title: Death toll jumps to 90 after Chinese coal mine blast
items.description: A gas explosion at a coal mine in northern China's Shanxi province has jumped to 90, state media reports. Nine people remain missing.

items.title: ASIO holiday warning did not flag elevated Hanukkah threat
items.description: Australia's intelligence agency, ASIO, issued its annual holiday threat assessment less than two weeks before the Hanukkah terrorist attack at Bondi Beach but did not identify heightened risks to the Jewish festival, despite earlier declaring antisemitism as its top priority in terms of threat to life.

items.title: A new battleground has started for Israel, where words trump actions
items.description: In the wake of an outcry over its treatment of detained activists, Israel has focused on messaging as its actions undermine its support from the international community.

items.title: Children's entertainer Danny Go!'s son dies of cancer aged 14
items.description: The popular children's YouTuber revealed the news after documenting the illness since it was diagnosed late last year. Tributes have flowed from Children's entertainers, including the Wiggles.

items.title: For Willie Rioli now is time to 'give back' to the place that gave him everything
items.description: The Tiwi Islands are unique and Australian Rules football is a way of life that has spawned some of the game's biggest names. But even as favourite son Willie Rioli Jr returns home, the Tiwi Bombers know they need more help.

items.title: Live: Pendlebury celebrates games record with hard-fought victory over West Coast
items.description: Collingwood's No.10 enjoys a 10-point win in his record-breaking match as the Magpies hold firm to down the Eagles at the MCG. Follow live.

items.title: Live: More boos at home for winless Dragons after another loss to Warriors
items.description: St George Illawarra is 0-10 to start the 2026 season after losing to the Warriors in Kogarah, where the locals let their feelings be known. Follow live.

items.title: The mission to save conjoined twin involved an airlift, five surgeons and a heartbreaking sacrifice
items.description: A team of doctors involved in the separation of conjoined Papua New Guinean twins Sawong and Tom have spoken for the first time about the rare and complex case.

items.title: Nine charts that reveal who pays more under Labor's tax changes
items.description: Labor's capital gains tax changes have set off a firestorm of debate about the implications for small businesses, start-ups, share owners and plenty more. Here's who will really pay more.

items.title: 'Beautiful, kind, caring man' dies in hospital months after alleged bashing
items.description: Friends of Darwin man Martin Wiberg, 48, are remembering him as a "very gentle soul" after he died in hospital this week.

items.title: Suzie Miller took the risky path away from a safe job as a judge, with no regrets
items.description: In 2009, Suzie Miller had a choice between becoming a magistrate in Australia or a residency at the National Theatre in London.

items.title: The perfect warm winter salad using crisp-roasted artichokes and grains
items.description: Crispy artichokes and textural grain make this salad a satisfying dinner and excellent next-day lunch.

items.title: The prickly plant powering a new spirits industry
items.description: Australia's emerging agave industry is attracting interest from distillers, farmers and scientists who believe the spiky plant could transform everything from tequila production to sustainable aviation fuel.

items.title: Tony Albert's form of optimism is a lesson for us all
items.description: Girramay, Yidinji and Kuku-Yalanji artist Tony Albert hopes to "take every item of 'Aboriginalia' in Australia out of circulation".

items.title: Caution and long-term thinking as budget adds to softening real estate market
items.description: After riding a post-COVID wave of booming prices, real estate agents say SA's housing market is starting to level out, as federal budget tax changes and rising interest rates reduce buyer appetite.

items.title: Black mould and broken toilets: Inside 'dismal' government-owned homes
items.description: Bug infestations, walls covered in black mould and broken toilets are just some of the issues plaguing homes in Australia's most isolated communities, where the landlord is the state government.

items.title: Brent Harvey is about to lose his place in AFL history
items.description: Brent 'Boomer' Harvey has enjoyed being the AFL/VFL games record holder for the past decade, and says he could have played more if he'd accepted an offer from other clubs to extend his career.

items.title: Charges withdrawn against artist for displaying Nazi symbols in artwork
items.description: The case has been dropped against an Australian artist charged with displaying Nazi symbols on an artwork depicting politicians and billionaires.

items.title: Giant iceberg with shipping containers spotted off Antarctica
items.description: Details of how the shipping containers ended up on a giant iceberg have been revealed in one of the more unusual reports tabled at the annual meeting of Antarctic Treaty nations.

items.title: Queensland jockey dies in hospital after training accident
items.description: Both of Shane McGovern's legs were amputated during a weeks-long stay in hospital.

items.title: Call to 911 reveals harrowing moments before NASCAR champ's death
items.description: A call to 911 reveals NASCAR champion Kyle Busch had been coughing up blood in the hours before his tragic death aged 41.
